description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-dirac-metrics-extension.
        Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the
        application depends on the Metrics extension; Maven resolves the transitive
        APT dependencies below automatically.
        Runs Dirac's processor on the application's classes: each bean with @Counted or
        @Timed, directly or through a stereotype, gets a $$DiracMetrics companion that lists its metrics, so the
        runtime registers them without scanning the bean's methods by reflection when
        the container starts (vidocq-workspace#38).
